title: Windows optional features
description: Desired state for Windows capabilities and classic optional features. Feature keys are exact native names. Capability keys may be exact native names or omit the tilde-delimited qualifier and version suffix when the remaining name uniquely identifies one catalog entry. Localized display names are not supported.

provider.description: The Windows servicing catalog that owns this exact resource name.

state.description: Whether the capability or feature is enabled. Disabling a classic feature retains its payload.
